sql: WITH RECURSIVE startk AS (SELECT 'R1-2307027' AS k UNION SELECT id FROM document WHERE number = 'R1-2307027' OR id = 'R1-2307027' UNION SELECT number FROM document WHERE (number = 'R1-2307027' OR id = 'R1-2307027') AND number IS NOT NULL), chain(x) AS (SELECT k FROM startk UNION SELECT r.later FROM chain JOIN revision r ON r.earlier = chain.x), later AS (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM chain WHERE x IS NOT NULL AND x NOT IN (SELECT k FROM startk WHERE k IS NOT NULL)), ld AS (SELECT later.x AS k, d.id AS did, d.number AS dnum, COALESCE(d.number, later.x) AS docnum FROM later LEFT JOIN document d ON (d.id = later.x OR d.number = later.x)), lk AS (SELECT k, docnum FROM ld UNION SELECT did, docnum FROM ld WHERE did IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT dnum, docnum FROM ld WHERE dnum IS NOT NULL), rd AS (SELECT lk.docnum AS docnum, dp.code AS code FROM lk JOIN disposition dp ON dp.target = lk.k JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id WHERE (lower(dp.evidence_status) LIKE '%verif%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%unverif%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%not%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%non%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%fail%' AND lower(dp.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%pending%' OR lower(dp.evidence_status) IN ('source','confirmed')) AND (lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(dp.scope) LIKE '%full%' OR lower(dp.scope) IN ('document','doc','tdoc','all'))), pk AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), rp AS (SELECT DISTINCT lk.docnum AS docnum, pk.pack_id AS pack_id FROM lk JOIN pk ON pk.cr = lk.k), rpp AS (SELECT rp.docnum AS docnum, cp.pack_number AS pack_number FROM rp JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.id = rp.pack_id UNION SELECT rp.docnum, cp.pack_number FROM rp JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.pack_number = rp.pack_id) SELECT DISTINCT rd.docnum AS final_document, rd.code AS disposition, rpp.pack_number AS cr_pack FROM rd JOIN rpp ON rpp.docnum = rd.docnum
